claims.text: The .agents-toolbar grid lays out filter labels and action buttons across twelve columns with a four-column fallback at 62rem and a single column at 34rem.
The .agent-card rule styles each agent entry with a bordered surface, accent top border, mono identity text and a wrapped actions row.
The .agents-table-scroll rules make the score table horizontally scrollable with tabular numerals and a caption header.

decision.rule: Change here when agents list layout, card presentation, table scrolling or responsive breakpoints needs to change.
decision.failure: Filters overlap on narrow viewports, identity text overflows, or the score table clips essential columns.

questions.q: Where are the agents toolbar breakpoints defined?
Where should I change agent card padding, borders or typography?
Where can I debug a score table that scrolls or clips on small screens?
